name: Madai for WooCommerce
author: madailtd

sections.description:
Stop discounting customers who would have paid full price

A coupon code lowers your price for everyone who finds it: the customer who needed an incentive, and the customer who would have paid full price. It can spread to coupon sites, and once customers see a lower price, your full price becomes harder to defend.

Madai works differently. Your prices never change. Visitors who want to pay less create value for your store through a few simple actions on the product page. Each action earns them part of the price. At checkout they use what they earned. Everyone else pays full price.

What your visitors do

On every promoted product, next to Add to cart, visitors see one simple option: Pay less with Madai.

  • They answer a question you wrote: which color, how much they would pay, where they would wear it.
  • They give you their email, if they want, with a clear yes. It goes to you.
  • More kinds of actions are on the way.

Every action counts on its own. Nobody has to finish a long form to get something. The value they earn is shown as they go, and part of it comes from everyone taking part in your promotion: the more people act, the more there is.

Every discount gives you something back

  • More sales from the visitors who were about to leave. They get a reason to buy now, and they earned it.
  • Your price, protected. The public price on your product page never moves. No codes to leak, no sale that makes full price look wrong.
  • What people really think. Every answer lands in your Madai panel, question by question, from people who were looking at that exact product.
  • Emails you can actually use, given with explicit consent, for your own newsletters.
  • Full control. You choose the products, how much of each price visitors can earn, how many items, and the actions. One product at 10%, another at 40%: it is your promotion.

Nothing to pay until a customer buys with Madai

No monthly fee, no setup fee. Nothing is charged until you sell.

You set one number per product: the most you give, everything included. Madai’s share is inside it. No sale, no cost: you pay only on orders where a customer used value earned with Madai, and the more generous you are, the smaller Madai’s share. Accepting customers brought by Madai Partners is your choice: when on, they cost 10% of what they pay. Your card is charged when what you owe reaches a threshold, or on the last day of the month, with an invoice each time. The full terms are at https://merchants.madai.com/terms/.

Keep your store. Keep your prices. Add Madai.

  • Classic cart and checkout, and the new block cart and checkout.
  • Your theme’s colors outside Madai’s own frame: the button and the checkout line look like your store.
  • No changes to your prices, products or orders beyond one line at checkout: Madai value.
  • Visitors see Madai in English or Italian, following the language of your store. More languages are coming.

How to start

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Madai in your WordPress menu and press Connect store.
  3. Open your Madai panel, pick your products, set how much of each price visitors can earn, and write your actions.
  4. Start your Campaign and register a card: nothing is charged until you sell. The button appears on your products.

External service

This plugin connects your store to Madai, a service run by Madai Ltd (United Kingdom). Without Madai the plugin does nothing, and it sends nothing to Madai until you press Connect store.

After you connect, your store talks only with https://api.madai.co.uk. Your Madai panel, and the page where you connect your store, open in your browser on https://app.madai.com.

  • When you connect: your store address, to link it to your Madai merchant account.
  • When a product page, the cart or the checkout is shown: which of your products are in a Madai promotion.
  • At checkout, when a customer uses Madai value: the products of your promotion in the cart, their quantities and amounts, the currency and the order total, to work out how much value applies.
  • When someone arrives from the link of a Madai partner: your store keeps a mark in a cookie in their browser for 3 months, and at checkout it sends that mark to Madai, so Madai knows which partner brought them. The mark holds no name and no email.
  • When an order with Madai value is placed, paid, cancelled or refunded: the order number and its status, so the value and Madai’s share follow the order.

Your customers’ names, addresses, emails and payment details are never sent by this plugin. Anyone who takes part does it inside a Madai window on your product page, served by api.madai.co.uk: whatever they give there, they give to Madai, under Madai’s privacy policy for shoppers. An email reaches you only when someone presses the button that gives it to you, after reading why you want it and your privacy notice.

A shopper who chooses Continue with Google signs in on the pages of Madai (app.madai.co.uk) and of Google, and comes back to the same page of your store: this plugin never talks to Google and receives nothing from it.

  • Madai merchant terms: https://merchants.madai.com/terms/
  • Madai privacy policy for merchants: https://merchants.madai.com/privacy/
  • Madai privacy policy for shoppers: https://madai.com/privacy-policy/
  • How Madai works: https://merchants.madai.com/
  • Support for merchants: merchants@madai.com
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes. Installing, connecting and running a promotion costs nothing. You pay only on orders where a customer used value earned with Madai.

Does Madai change my prices?

Never. Your public price stays exactly as you set it. Only customers who create value with Madai can pay less, and only at checkout, through a separate Madai value line.

Is this a loyalty or points program?

No. There are no points, no levels, no cards. Value is earned on your products, for your promotion, and used on your products.

Is this a survey plugin?

No. Madai is a promotion system. Questions are just one of the ways visitors can create value for your store in exchange for a lower price. You choose what you want to learn, and every answer is available in your Madai panel.

Do people who take part need an account?

Not to start. Visitors can begin earning immediately, without creating an account. They only sign in when they want to keep what they earned and use it at checkout. It takes a few seconds and happens inside Madai. Your store never sees their Madai password.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The button and the checkout line disappear from your store. Orders already placed keep the Madai value they were given.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

The plugin also removes its settings and the connection of this store. Orders keep their Madai value line, and your Campaigns stay in your Madai panel. To use Madai again, install it and press Connect store. Stop your running Campaigns in your Madai panel first: once the plugin is gone, the value people earned cannot be used in your store.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes, with both the classic and the block cart and checkout.
sections.changelog:
0.8.19

  • The Madai showcase of the [madai_take_part] shortcode appears as soon as a Campaign is live, even on a page kept in the cache of the host, and takes its height at once when the page loads its scripts late.

0.8.18

  • Your Madai panel and the page where you connect your store open on app.madai.com.

0.8.17

  • Customers brought by Madai Partners are remembered; two order notes and this page say Madai’s share.

0.8.16

  • The plugin page of a store not yet connected says what Madai does and has one button, Connect store; once connected, it no longer shows Powered by Madai, and the Madai button carries the Madai dot.

0.8.15

  • The Madai pages for merchants moved to merchants.madai.com: the plugin page, the merchant terms, the merchant privacy policy and the support address merchants@madai.com.

0.8.14

  • Shoppers can continue with Google in the Madai window: the page goes to Google and comes back to the same product page or checkout, with the Madai window open again and signed in.

0.8.13

  • When an order is paid, the plugin tells Madai the date WooCommerce keeps for the payment, so the Madai statement shows when each order was ordered and when it was paid.
  • At checkout the Madai line is the same button as on the product page, Pay less with Madai.
  • The admin menu is called Madai for WooCommerce, and Remove next to the Madai value can be translated.
  • Deleting the plugin also removes the key it keeps today in the customers’ sessions.

0.8.12

  • The plugin is called Madai for WooCommerce everywhere.
  • Scripts and styles are files of the plugin, loaded the way WordPress loads them. Nothing changes for the store or its customers.
  • The order status route answers only requests signed by Madai with the store’s keys.
  • Translations are no longer shipped inside the plugin: they will come from translate.wordpress.org.

0.8.11

  • The address of the Madai service can be set in wp-config.php, for test stores. Nothing changes for other stores.

0.8.10

  • The Madai window speaks the language of the page: on a store in Italian the customer reads Madai in Italian, from the product to the checkout.
  • Italian translation of the sentences the customer reads in the store.

0.8.9

  • A cart with products of more than one Madai promotion uses all of them at checkout: one figure, one gesture, one Madai value line.

0.8.8

  • At checkout the words of the Madai line sit next to the ball, on the left, with any theme.
  • On the product page the small line sits right under the Madai button, with space after it.

0.8.7

  • At checkout the Madai button sits under its line, as wide as the order summary, and never leaves it.
  • A clearer line in the cart: the value earned with Madai is waiting at checkout.
  • The plugin names its author, Madai.

0.8.6

  • The block cart and checkout load for every visitor on stores that defer JavaScript, such as SiteGround Speed Optimizer with Defer Render-blocking JavaScript.

0.8.5

  • One word for the store everywhere, the word WooCommerce uses.

0.8.4

  • Plainer words on the settings page, under the button and in the order notes, which can now be translated.
  • The overlay always adds the product to the cart when the visitor asks: the setting that turned it off is gone.

0.8.3

  • First public version.
